meta.scope: Read-only research control surface. This map does not alter live Layer 1 or Layer 2 decisions.

release_gate.title: Do not release a directional call until all gates pass
requirements: Unseen-period directional accuracy is above 50% after flats are handled by the locked contract.
Each confidence band is calibrated against realised outcomes with sufficient sample size.
The result is stable across time splits and does not depend on one asset, regime, or factor.

stages.label: Lock the 24H contract
stages.evidence: Outcome and flat-band rules are defined in the checker contract.
stages.next_action: Keep the definition frozen while testing so results remain comparable.

stages.label: Rebuild historical calls
stages.evidence: Historical checker artifacts exist for the five current Layer 1 assets.
stages.next_action: Extend only with timestamp-safe inputs; never use information published after the call time.

stages.label: Find stable variables
stages.evidence: Factor Edge Lab identifies candidate evidence, but factor-level ADR/L2L joins remain incomplete.
stages.next_action: Test each factor and factor combination across independent time periods, then remove unstable candidates.

stages.label: Prove selective accuracy
stages.evidence: The Phase 2 shadow comparison improves two assets, with three assets still mixed or awaiting stronger evidence.
stages.next_action: Measure only the calls the gate would actually allow, separately by asset and confidence band.

stages.label: Calibrate confidence
stages.evidence: Confidence-band delivery exists, but calibration must be demonstrated on a separate unseen period.
stages.next_action: Compare stated confidence bands with realised win rates and reject bands that are not honest or well sampled.

stages.label: Pass unseen validation
stages.evidence: Walk-forward, stability, and selectivity modules exist, but their evidence is not yet unified into one release decision.
stages.next_action: Run time-ordered holdout tests and require every release gate to pass before a live-trading recommendation.
